subject: Leveling question for candidate Alex Garcia — L5 vs L6 / IC vs Manager
messages:
From: Emily Reed <emily@recruitco.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Candidate Alex Garcia — Senior ML Engineer recommendation (L5/L6)

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note on Alex Garcia (resume attached). Hiring manager is excited — recommends between L5 and L6 depending on scope. Key signals:
- 8 years ML experience, lead on infra for low-latency ranking at FinTechX (cross-team impact claimed).
- Published 2 conference papers; one OSS contribution used internally by FinTechX.
- Managed a small team (informal lead) for the last 18 months but not a formal manager on org chart.

Hiring manager asks for a calibration call: they see either a) L5 Senior IC with manager-track note, or b) L6 Senior IC if we prioritize cross-org technical leadership and impact. Compensation expectation is $220k–$260k base + 0.25%–0.6% equity depending on level. Candidate is open to manager track but prefers IC.

I attached Alex's resume and a preliminary offer draft (numbers placeholder). Can you advise how you want to position level/title and the internal sign-off flow?

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Reed
Senior Recruiter, RecruitCo
attachments: Alex_Garcia_Resume.pdf, offer_draft_v1.docx

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Candidate Alex Garcia — Senior ML Engineer recommendation (L5/L6)

Team — forwarding Emily's note. Hiring manager (Ben Carter) is leaning toward L5 with manager track as a compromise. Finance will need HC confirmation because this is a new req (headcount from Q4 hire plan). Two asks: 1) leveling recommendation (L5 vs L6, and whether to mark as manager-track), 2) compensation anchoring (base + equity + sign-on).

Context: candidate prefers IC; manager wants to leave manager option open. Resume and offer draft attached. If we go L6, we should expect to push to the higher band and open a compensation exception if needed.

Proposed timeline: finalize level by EOD Wed 11/17, get HC approval from Laura if cost delta > $25k.

-Jasmine
Attachments: Alex_Garcia_Resume.pdf, offer_draft_v1.docx

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate Alex Garcia — Senior ML Engineer recommendation (L5/L6)

Jasmine — quick thoughts (TL;DR: L5 with manager-track OR L6 if confirmed cross-org impact):

- Based on resume, Alex looks like a strong problem solver and has published work, but formal people-manage experience is limited.
- If Ben wants a manager in the role, title could be "Senior ML Engineer (L5) — manager-track" and we list a performance checkpoint at 6–9 months for a manager conversion.
- L6 should be reserved for clear IC leaders who drive platform adoption across multiple teams and have documented org-wide impact. We don't yet have external metrics showing adoption (OSS stars, cross-team KPIs).

Comp recommendation: anchor base at $225k for L5, equity 0.35% and $10k sign-on (relocation not expected). If we move to L6, base ~ $245k, equity ~0.5%, sign-on negotiable ($15–20k).

If Laura okays the budget, I'm fine with L5 manager-track to preserve career path without overspending.

-Tessa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate Alex Garcia — leveling calibration notes

Looping in more leveling context. Quoting Emily below for clarity: 
> Candidate prefers IC; manager track optional. 8 years exp, 2 publications, led infra efforts.

My read: candidate is on the cusp. Important to be explicit about the role expectations we offer. If we mark manager-track but hire as L5, the compensation/benchmarks must reflect likely promotion within 12 months if performance matches. We should include a short "promotion plan" in the offer appendix so expectations are clear to the candidate and people ops.

Cost considerations: moving from the L5 anchor to L6 will increase on-target comp by ~12% base and ~40–60% more equity expense. That materially affects our Q4 hiring spend cap. If we need to secure a $25k delta, Laura's HC approval is required per policy.

Suggested numbers (finalized for approval):
- Offer A (L5 Senior IC, manager-track): Base $228,000; Equity 0.36%; Sign-on $12,000; 15 days PTO accrual at hire.
- Offer B (L6 Senior IC): Base $248,000; Equity 0.50%; Sign-on $18,000.

If team strongly believes Alex will be a technical leader across products, go Offer B and we fast-track HC sign-off. Otherwise, Offer A with a 6–9 month promotion checkpoint and explicit manager conversion plan.

Please confirm which offer to send to candidate; I'll prepare equity wording and the promotion appendix. Also confirm whether we should include a retention clause tied to key deliverables for manager conversion to make the promotion criteria objective.

-Marissa

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2026 11:35:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Candidate Alex Garcia — updated offer recommendation and docs

Attached: offer_draft_v2.docx (Offer A populated). Per alignment: team prefers Offer A (L5 Senior IC, manager-track) — matches candidate preference for IC while giving an explicit path to manager if they opt in. Proposed comp: Base $230,000; Equity 0.40%; Sign-on $12,000.

Laura — can you confirm HC availability and sign-off for Offer A? If base+equity pushes us >$25k vs original plan, we will need your explicit approval to proceed. If you prefer, I can also prepare Offer B numbers for your review if you think we should invest to lock candidate at L6.

Thanks — aiming to get verbal acceptance before Thanksgiving if possible.
Attachments: offer_draft_v2.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Candidate Alex Garcia — final sign-off request

Thanks for the clear options and numbers. I approve Offer A (L5 Senior IC, manager-track) with the following conditions:

1) Approve base $230,000, equity 0.40%, sign-on $12,000.
2) Add a 6-month promotion checkpoint and an objective 90-day plan tied to cross-team deliverables; if the manager track is activated, we will formalize manager responsibilities and comp adjustments at the checkpoint.
3) Finance: please confirm HC cost center and that this hire fits within the Q4 hiring spend cap. If finance flags a >$25k variance, loop me immediately.
4) Legal: route the attached offer_draft_v2.docx to legal for the equity clause review.

Please proceed to extend Offer A to Alex and let me know once we have a verbal. Good work keeping the candidate's preference front-and-center.

-Laura
VP Eng, Redwood Inference
attachments: offer_draft_v2.docx
